notes: 39.2.8 is a polish-only follow-up to the functionally validated 39.2.7 window model.
Administrator window controls are visually smaller and less intrusive while preserving direct always-visible actions and the same semantics.
Reduced restore bars keep + Restaurer followed by × pinned at the far right; reduce still does not suspend runtime.

Atlas Math Core keeps its Classic docked behavior. On first detach it opens as a medium right-side instrument (about 42% viewport width, capped), while Latéral/Dessus/Réduire remain native Math Core controls and maximize stays explicit.
Graphique, Target Top, Market Flow, Market Snapshot, Math Core and the other operational windows keep the same 12-unit contract and no business DOM clone is introduced.
Metal Base 39.1, Market Engine 38.15.11 and all market/Atlas/NØX/Aerith/Memory/Bridge/Ollama business logic remain unchanged by this polish layer.
